beta.notes:
WireProof 0.52.0 (beta)

- Shared company and printer profiles in the Parts Database: File → Settings… → Company (company name, export logo, label logo, Logo on labels) and → Label printer (tape, margins, the wire / harness / box label layouts). Load makes a profile this PC's; Save profile, Save as new profile…, Delete… and Locked are the Designer's. The Windows printer stays per PC.
- The project remembers its company profile (Project Properties → Company); title block, exports and labels name that company with its logos.
- Builder and Viewer read the whole Parts Database (panel, BOM catalog lines, Design Rule Check catalog rules, photos, profiles) and change nothing in it.
- Photo sync: a photo replaced by another file type shows the new one; an upload no longer hides another PC's newer photos.
